Zuran+drag: glide slot running at release, 6 pans handled, release 251.5 from the destination, end 0.000 (trail 126.2, 19.4, 0.09, 0); Pratzen+wheel: 246.9 -> 0.000; Allied+drag: 371.5 -> 0.000; phase arc (PageDown 04:00->07:00)+drag: 116.7 from the end, which is exactly presetFrame(PHASES[1].cam); freeCam true (Follow off) at every end. verdicts.notes: Scope: the landscape only; the paper map's MAPCAM already ends its glide on input (stop() app.js:4915, called by pan 4917 and zoomAt 4919; glide step 4952-4953), so the remedy's MAPCAM part is unneeded.
